nodes.text: Mind the gate latch — Bess leans on it when she's bored. Something I can do for you?

choices.text: Mind if I practice my swings out here?

nodes.text: Walk up to a cow with kind intentions and you'll come away with *milk* — Bess allows it, mostly. The hens drop *eggs* when the mood takes them; check the coop floor. Milk, eggs, berries from the brook — that's a breakfast nobody had to bleed for. The world will ask you to bleed for plenty later, so enjoy this part.

Not on my girls, you don't — the hens have opinions and Bess holds grudges. Take it to the *old shed* past the ford; the rats there owe everyone in this village. And if a chicken squares up to you anyway… well. You'd win. Try to be gracious about it.
That's Pip. Mine, allegedly, though I suspect the Ring left him too and the stones won't own up to it. If he asks you what being made of stones is like, I apologize in advance.
Aye, it's a good little patch. Gate latch! — sorry. Habit.
